issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit list --page-size N` passes any number to the API, which rejects a page size of 100 or more with a 422.

## Fix

Validate `--page-size` before the call. The upper bound is exclusive: accept 1 through 99, and reject 0, 100 and anything larger with the error `page size must be 1-99`. Non-integers are rejected the same way.

## Done when

- [ ] 1 and 99 are accepted.
- [ ] 0 and 100 are rejected with `page size must be 1-99`.
- [ ] Tests cover those four values.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): reject page sizes the API refuses
pr.body: Validates --page-size against the 1-99 range the issue states, with tests at both edges.
